verdict.rationale: Porkbun has no native concept of versioned automations or rollback. It does provide adjacent review aids: a dryRun flag that runs every pre-flight check without committing, a full sandbox key for testing automations against simulated state, and signed webhooks for DNS changes that could feed an audit trail. Versioning and rollback would be left to the user's own tooling. Missing for 10: versioning of automations or configurations, DNS/config change history, one-click or API rollback, and any independent corroboration.
